verdicts.reason: The two candidates look pixel-identical. Both shrink the plan cards until the MONTHLY/YEARLY/FAMILY labels and the 'per month' text can't be read, and they put the cards in the wrong order (6, 80, 48), so the highlighted yearly plan is no longer in the middle. Both also jam the subhead and the legal text into a cramped block against the right edge, where the fine print is almost as big as the supporting copy, so the hierarchy breaks down.
